messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] getting error in init section
parts:
Hi Sedat,

My hunch is that you're trying to enter the template directly into the R console, which will not work. I pasted the code you sent below into a file called SedatTemplate.txt. I then ran createModels with that input:

library(MplusAutomation)
createModels("SedatTemplate.txt")

This created the four inp files as requested. So, my suggestion is the create your template file in some text editor (Notepad++ is good on Windows, Aquamacs is good on Mac.. or whatever you prefer), then run it as above in R.

Best,
Michael
